Explore Titanium Dioxide ProductsRequest a Quote

COMPANY & SUPPLY

Who operates TiO2Products?

TiO2Products is the commercial website operated by IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD., a rutile titanium dioxide manufacturer and supplier based in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia. Its listed grades cover coatings, plastics, masterbatch, printing inks and paper. Buyers can request grade-specific documents and discuss international sourcing requirements.

About the operating company →

TECHNICAL EVALUATION

How to select a titanium dioxide grade

Start with the formulation and end-use requirements, then compare grade-specific data and test candidate pigments in the intended system.

What does industrial TiO₂ do?

Titanium dioxide pigment contributes whiteness and opacity in coatings, plastics, masterbatch, printing inks and paper. The required grade depends on the formulation and processing conditions.

What should buyers compare?

Review the product data, relevant surface treatment, dispersion, optical properties and processing needs. Confirm suitability through application testing rather than relying on a product group or process label alone.

Review grade-specific product information →

PRODUCTION PROCESSES

Titanium Dioxide by Production Process

Evaluating a Chemours Ti-Pure Alternative

If a Ti-Pure grade is your current reference, record the exact grade, formulation and acceptance criteria before evaluating another source. No automatic equivalence is implied.

Read the Ti-Pure alternative evaluation guide →

What technical information should buyers review?

Review the product data sheet and the grade’s stated properties, then check application fit in the intended formulation. Ask for additional documents when a specific purchasing requirement calls for them.

Product and procurement documents →

How do I choose a titanium dioxide grade?

Match the end use, formulation and processing conditions to grade-specific data, then test shortlisted pigments in the intended system.

Explore TiO₂ application guidance →

What information is needed for a TiO₂ quotation?

Provide the application, destination, preferred grade if known, expected quantity, packaging needs and any documents required for the purchase.

Request a Quote →
